== Summary ==
Group photograph of attendees at the [[2023 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency, Morristown, New Jersey). Faces are numbered left to right across the photograph (standing, kneeling and seated together). 32 people are named and 42 are unknown; at least one more face behind no. 4 is hidden.

* '''Identification:''' Faces matched on 25 November 2026 to named photographs of each person (2022–2026 events, Holotheatre stills and award portraits); [[Benji Chu]] by the Team Albany shirt and deck box in the original caption. Unknown faces and the 2023 players still to place are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]].
